rationale: Create one standalone Channelview Cogeneration asset record while correcting the stale census implication that GIP remains a current owner. GIP and Fortistar acquired the plant in 2008 and fully exited to Energy Investors Funds in 2014. Ares subsequently became the fund manager and retained 3% when Elliott acquired 97% in 2025. BlackRock's 2024 acquisition of GIP's manager occurred a decade after the asset exit and is not a Channelview ownership transfer.

afterImage.name: Channelview Cogeneration
afterImage.description: Channelview Cogeneration is an operating natural-gas-fired combined-cycle cogeneration plant at 8580 Sheldon Road in Channelview, Texas. The facility supplies steam and part of its electricity to the adjacent Equistar Chemicals / LyondellBasell complex and sells excess power into ERCOT. Current operating scope is reported at approximately 851 MW, while EIA-derived technical figures use different nameplate and summer-capacity conventions. Elliott Investment Management acquired 97% in July 2025 and the Ares-managed EIF United States Power Fund IV structure retained 3%. GIP and Fortistar were former owners from 2008 until their completed 2014 exit. BlackRock's later acquisition of GIP's manager did not transfer the plant, and no subsequent sale, shutdown or signed pending ownership transaction was identified through August 29, 2026.
